factors.label: Service Coverage & Delivery Reach
factors.crm: R1: Implement waitlist & demand capture before capital commitment

factors.label: Competitor Pull: Alternative Attractiveness & Variety
factors.integrated_note: Supported in former-user behavior, but correlation weakens post-centering in current users
factors.crm: R2: Deploy stock-out recovery & substitute discovery pilots

factors.label: Competitor Promotions & Pricing
factors.integrated_note: Secondary filings and former users show pricing pressure, but centered survey CI spans zero
factors.crm: Targeted retention offers; avoid blanket margin erosion

factors.label: Switching Effort & Perceived Barriers
factors.integrated_note: Positive raw correlation (+0.721) opposite to PPM theory; collapses to +0.05 post-centering; HTMT=0.923
factors.crm: R4: Re-measure switching barriers with multi-dimensional scale; no artificial customer lock-in

factors.label: Satisfaction (Push Factor)
factors.integrated_note: Weak non-significant raw association (+0.170); satisfaction does not protect against multi-homing
factors.crm: R5: Track repeat fulfillment and recovery rather than passive satisfaction metrics

factors.label: Familiarity & Inertia (Mooring Factors)
factors.integrated_note: Non-significant associations after Holm adjustment; habitual behavior insufficient to prevent competitive experimentation
factors.crm: R4 / Continuous engagement: avoid relying on habitual loyalty without behavioral validation
